meta.name: linkedin-humanizer
meta.description: Remove the AI tells human readers and LinkedIn's AI-slop filter react to in a post or comment: 2026 vocabulary by paragraph density, reveal bridges, staccato fragments, stacked triads, performed sincerity. Tiered rewriter (forensic / strict / aesthetic / all) plus `--mode audit` pass-fail review and `--mode profile` voice profile builder. Not for beating AI detectors (no edit reliably does). Keywords: humanize, de-AI, reads like ChatGPT, AI slop, scrub AI tells, review this draft, audit before posting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把帖子草稿里的机器腔调改掉,读起来更像真人写的
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常在 LinkedIn 发帖,却担心文字透出一股 AI 味。
copy.tagline_en: Strip robotic AI tone from drafts so they read like a real person wrote them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on LinkedIn often but worry your text sounds AI-generated.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能重写帖子或评论，删掉 AI 写作痕迹，产出改写文、改动对比、逐句人味估计和置信度；也可只做发布前审核，返回通过/不通过和问题清单。
howto.when: 要发布 AI 起草的帖子或评论、草稿读着不对劲但说不清哪里怪时触发；说「humanize」「de-AI」「audit before posting」等词也会触发。

say.text: 帮我 humanize 这条帖子，去掉 AI 味
发布前审计一下这篇草稿
say.note: 只检测不重写，给出 Blockers 和 Warnings

say.text: 用 aesthetic 模式重写，破折号和三项并列也处理
say.note: 会一并压平文学性写法

howto.what_en: Claude rewrites a post or comment to strip AI writing tells, returning the rewrite, a diff, per-sentence perplexity estimates and a confidence label; audit mode only reviews a draft and returns blockers and warnings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're about to publish an AI-drafted post or comment, or when a draft feels off; also on phrases like "humanize", "de-AI", or "audit before posting".

say_en.text: Humanize this LinkedIn post and remove the AI tells
Audit this draft before I post it
say_en.note: Detection only, returns blockers and warnings

say_en.text: Rewrite in aesthetic mode, catch em dashes and triads
